question: What salvific role and inner disposition characterize the all-pervading lord in contemplation?
premises: The lord has removed the burden of the earth.
The lord possesses a serene heart.
inference: The practitioner should contemplate the all-pervading lord as the remover of earth's burden with a serene heart.
plain_english: Visualize the all-pervading lord who has removed the burden of the earth and whose heart is serene.
